title: Are these safe for cats?
technique: The Dip (H174) as a grey 25 s blockout (@Video1): cuts, shot sizes, camera moves and pacing only; the flip is written in words at its 9-11 s flight.
story: Night, candles everywhere: a cat lady scrolls the Fig & Cedar page up and down, not buying.
Inner voice, lips closed, the camera circling her: “Are these safe for cats?”
She finds nothing, gets annoyed, closes the site: “I guess we'll never know.”
The camera flips down to the owner: “I guess no one's interested in Fig and Cedar. No one wants this.”
“Time to discontinue the product line.” She blows out the candle.
Scout: “Don't guess why your shoppers don't buy.” “Scout interviews your shoppers for you. Get free early access.”
